enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

enchantments.text: The Moral CompassWhile wearing these Handwraps, Monks will gain additional power and bonuses based on their Philosophy.
enchantments.tooltip: An oft repeated mantra of the Shintao is written on these sacred handwraps:"True strength comes from within, and true power comes from rising above."

children.text: Grants the following bonuses to characters with at least 3 Monk levels:

children.tooltip: Axiomatic 6: This weapon is righteous and wielded by those who stand against chaos, dealing an additional 6d6 law damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon lawfully aligned. (Chaotic characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.)

children.text: Holy 6 if on the Path of Inevitable Dominion
children.tooltip: Holy 6: This weapon is wielded by the pure to smite the wicked, dealing an additional 6d6 good damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon good aligned. Evil characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.

children.text: Unholy 6 if on the Path of Harmonious Balance
children.tooltip: Unholy 6: On Hit: 6 to 36 Evil damage. Evil-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Good user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.

children.text: Enhanced Ki +3 if character has 20 Monk levels
children.tooltip: Enhanced Ki +3: Increases the rate at which the user gains ki with each successful attack.

Vampirism 3: This weapon thirsts for the blood of your enemies, healing you for +3d2 hit points with each hit.Note: internal cooldown of 1 second.
